svg.text: Numbering typo (TC) · TC · Temporal_ID: s3_1; s3_3
Current text
(1)為施行本規例，監督可不時認可任何根據香港以外地方法律有權作出以下事宜的實體，
作為該地方的發證實體 ——(a)檢驗食品；及
(a)就食品
是否適宜供人食用，發出證明。 | (3)監督可
——(a)更改規限某發證實體的認可的條件；或
(a)撤銷
該項認可。
Counterpart — English
(1) For the purposes of these regulations, the Authority may from time to time recognize as an
issuing entity of a place outside Hong Kong any entity having power under the laws of that
place— (a) to examine articles of food; and
(b) to certify
as to their fitness for human
consumption. | (3) The Authority may— (a) vary the conditions to which the recognition of an
issuing entity is subject; or
(b) cancel
the recognition.
Suggested correction
s. 3(1): “(a)檢驗食品；及(b)就食品是否適宜供人食用，發出證明。”; s. 3(3): “(a)
更改規限某發證實體的認可的條件；或(b)撤銷該項認可。” The underlying <num value>, name and
Temporal_ID must be corrected at the same time in both subsections.
